origin.private_observation: Two retrospective trials used different assignments: author-route replay followed by a separately requested independent method construction. The dispatch itself was a confounder.

design: Reuse D53 candidate methods and alternatives, D54 intent=study and authority, D51 task/run, and the existing independent review. Research can end with a retained, rejected, or unresolved candidate. No new global workflow stage.

probe.scope: one offline synthetic fluorescence problem, two fresh agents with matching model and input
probe.baseline: Compared blank-corrected scaling to a raw ratio, measured cross-plate range, proposed held-out repeat and tolerance.
probe.pilot: Made the same quantitative comparison and specified when to try multipoint calibration.
probe.interpretation: Both acted autonomously; this trial does not establish a change in ability, latency or error rate. The template and dispatch changes were not independently randomized.

deferred: The view now reads stage exits from the bundled design. Check compatibility of remaining phase, intent and status constants separately.
Represent revision links and ambiguous active branches explicitly.
